decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.822. Series context: trend strength 0.7042 and seasonal strength 0.2598; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.251); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.863.
